note: Remote-source inlet: a SOURCES/ pack declares an IMAP mailbox to watch; each new message becomes a run of watch-mailbox/_source/0, which records it (deduped by @source.key), and the poller then moves it to Processed. The full poll loop needs the source personality AND a mailbox password in the secret store, so it is a MANUAL run (see the README) — like inbound-support-mailbox, whose real exercise is also out-of-band. The automated checks here cover the HTTP surface that stands on its own: POST /seed provisions the local watched account (via --imap) and drops a message in, and GET /received lists what the source has pulled (0 until you run --source with the secret set). Baseline `apply --dry-run` proves the SOURCES/ pack, the _source stack, and the seed/received ops all parse and carry through apply.

checks.name: seed provisions the watched account and appends a message
seed without a password is a 400 before any op runs
received lists what the source has pulled (empty without --source)
